description: Defines the MainResourceHandler class which manages resource loading, including obtaining streams, URLs, and resource metadata, for configuration files within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: MainResourceHandler
classes.description: A final class implementing ResourceHandler that manages resource loading and metadata for configuration files.

methods.name: MainResourceHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing with filename and XML element or explicit loader and location.

methods.name: getLoaderName
methods.description: Returns the loader name used for resource loading.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Reads and returns the XML document from the resource stream.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Provides an InputStream to the resource.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the resource.

methods.name: isFileResource
methods.description: Checks if the resource loader is a FileLoader instance.

methods.name: getFullLocation
methods.description: Returns the full location string of the resource.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on loaderName, xmlFilename, and location.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on filename, loader, and location.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the resource handler.
